name: film-cool-girl-moment
image_vibe: Raw 90s point-and-shoot, Kodak Gold 200 warmth, indie sleaze, effortlessly cool
image_purpose: Create a candid record-store discovery moment with authentic compact-camera energy.

prompt.project_info: A candid vintage-film lifestyle portrait set in a cramped record store.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman crouching beside record crates, excitedly holding a vinyl record toward the camera. She wears a fully opaque white camisole, an opaque charcoal mini skirt with secure coverage, black lace socks, and black loafers. A mustard-yellow bag rests beside her.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium shot from slightly above, subject roughly centered but framed as a casual imperfect snapshot. Include stacked vinyl crates, band posters, cluttered shelves, and the mustard-yellow bag.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct frontal on-camera flash with hard shadows on the wall, cool flash highlights on skin, warm surrounding tones, raw authentic 90s point-and-shoot mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm compact-camera perspective, Kodak Gold 200 film simulation, warm amber tones, deep rich blacks, visible grain, candid messy framing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a medium candid 35mm compact-camera portrait of an original adult woman crouching in a cramped vintage record store, holding up a vinyl record she just found. Frame from slightly above with imperfect casual snapshot composition. She wears a fully opaque white camisole, an opaque charcoal mini skirt with secure coverage, black lace socks, and black loafers; place a mustard-yellow bag beside her. Use direct frontal on-camera flash, hard wall shadows, Kodak Gold 200 warmth, cool flash highlights, deep blacks, visible grain, and an indie-sleaze 90s point-and-shoot mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, exposed underwear, transparent clothing, nudity, soft studio lighting, bokeh, airbrushed skin, over-processed image, distorted anatomy, watermark, text

assets.name: source record-store reference
assets.usage: Use only for record-store composition, flash treatment, wardrobe palette, and film mood; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the excited vinyl-discovery concept, candid framing, Kodak Gold palette, and direct-flash aesthetic. Keep the subject clearly adult and all clothing opaque with secure coverage.

changes: Added secure opaque coverage for the camisole and mini skirt and safety exclusions.
